citation: Chang C-K, et al. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2016;13:20
protocol: 8-h fast; cycle ergometer at 60% of VO2max (to exhaustion; time to exhaustion in figure), 1 h after placebo juice; blood before, at 15 and 30 min of exercise, and immediately after
population: 12 healthy physically active adults (6 M, 6 F), 22.6 +/- 1.1 y, BMI 21.7 +/- 3.2
note: Placebo (control) rows of a mangosteen crossover; SD is in parentheses after each mean; heart rate and RPE are in a figure.
